dialogue.origin: (こんばんは、本日はよろしくお願いいたします。お時間になりましたら、始めさせていただきます。)
dialogue.content: (Good evening. Thank you for coming today. We will begin when it's time.)

dialogue.origin: (こんばんは。こちらこそよろしくお願いします。)
dialogue.content: (Good evening. Thank you for having me.)

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、相談員ですはじめに、年齢、性別、本日お話しされたいことをお聞かせください
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm your counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。42才女性、姑のこと
dialogue.content: Good evening. I’m a 42-year-old woman. It’s about my mother-in-law.

dialogue.origin: 教えていただきありがとうございますお姑さんのことでお悩みなのですねお姑さんのどのようなことにお悩みなのか、具体的に教えていただきますか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that. It sounds like you're troubled by your mother-in-law. Could you tell me more specifically what about her is bothering you?

dialogue.origin: 主人が姑の肩ばかりもって腹が立ちます
dialogue.content: My husband always takes his mother’s side, and it makes me angry.

dialogue.origin: なるほどそうなのですねそれは、イライラしてしまいますね
dialogue.content: I see, so that's how it is. That must be very frustrating.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どんな時にそうお感じになりますか？
dialogue.content: When do you tend to feel that way?

dialogue.origin: 子供の事で私と姑の教育方針が違った時も、2人の前で姑の味方をします
dialogue.content: Even when my mother-in-law and I have different approaches to the children’s upbringing, he takes her side right in front of both of us.

dialogue.origin: うん、うん、そうなんですねそれはなんだか責められているような感じになってしまいますね
dialogue.content: Mhm, mhm, I see. That must make you feel as if you're being blamed.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 他にはどんなことがありますか？
dialogue.content: Are there any other instances?

dialogue.origin: 家を建てるか建てないかでも、結局姑の意見が通りました
dialogue.content: Even when it came to deciding whether or not to build a house, my mother-in-law's opinion won out in the end.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねそれは頭にきますね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be infuriating.

dialogue.origin: はい、頭に間にきます
dialogue.content: Yes, it is infuriating.

dialogue.origin: 他にもございますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything else?

dialogue.origin: 細かい事は沢山あります。
dialogue.content: There are many little things.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね挙げるとたくさんでてきそうなのですね
dialogue.content: I see. It sounds like if you started listing them, there would be quite a lot.

dialogue.origin: ご主人はいつからお姑さんの肩を持つようになったとお感じですか？
dialogue.content: When do you feel your husband started taking your mother-in-law’s side?

dialogue.origin: 姑とあった時はそんな感じがありましたが、近くに住んで会う回数が増え余計に感じます
dialogue.content: I felt that way when we saw her, but now that we live nearby and see her more often, I feel it even more.

dialogue.origin: なるほどもともとという感じでしたが、合う回数が多くなってからそう感じることが増えたということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. So it had been there to begin with, and you feel it more frequently now that you’ve been seeing her more often. Is that correct?

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねそうなると、お姑さんと会うのが煩わしくなってしまいますね
dialogue.content: I see. In that case, seeing your mother-in-law must be starting to feel like a burden.

dialogue.origin: 別に嫌いでは無いですが、主人の態度に腹が立ちます
dialogue.content: It's not that I dislike her, but my husband's attitude makes me angry.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ、そうお感じなんですねお姑さんのことよりもご主人にイライラしてしまいますよねそう感じるのは最もなことだと思います
dialogue.content: Yes, yes, I understand that's how you feel. You get more frustrated with your husband than with your mother-in-law. I think it's perfectly reasonable to feel that way.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご主人とお姑さんは普段はどういったご関係性ですか？
dialogue.content: What is your husband's relationship with his mother usually like?

dialogue.origin: 普通の親子関係だと思います。
dialogue.content: I think it's a normal parent-child relationship.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですねちなみにご主人はご兄弟はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: I see. By the way, does your husband have any siblings?

dialogue.origin: 兄が1人います
dialogue.content: He has one older brother.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございますそうなのですねお義兄さんとお姑さんとの関係はどうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. I see. And what is the relationship like between your brother-in-law and your mother-in-law?

dialogue.origin: 同じような感じですが、兄はまだ1人なので実家で好きにしているようです。
dialogue.content: It's similar, but his brother is still single, so he seems to do as he pleases at their parents' house.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね教えていただきありがとうございます
dialogue.content: I see. Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.origin: 普段はご主人はどんな方ですか？
dialogue.content: What is your husband like normally?

dialogue.origin: 普段はちゃんと話のできる人だと思います。
dialogue.content: Normally, I think he's someone I can talk to properly.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね相談者様とお二人でいるときは、きちんとお話ができる方なんですね
dialogue.content: I see. When it's just the two of you, he's someone you can have a proper conversation with.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, that’s right.

dialogue.origin: 相談者様にとっても素敵なご主人なんですね
dialogue.content: It sounds like he is a wonderful husband to you.

dialogue.origin: そうなんでしょうか、最近はその事もあってあまりそう思えませんが
dialogue.content: I wonder. Lately, because of this issue, I can't really think of him that way.

dialogue.origin: そうお感じになるのですねご主人に対して、少し不信感のようなものがあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: That's how you're feeling. Do you perhaps feel a bit of mistrust towards your husband?

dialogue.origin: 今はご主人にどういったお気持ちがありますか？
dialogue.content: How do you feel about your husband right now?

dialogue.origin: 今はそうかもしれません
dialogue.content: Perhaps I do right now.

dialogue.origin: すみません、かぶってしまいました　他にどういったお気持ちがありそうですか？
dialogue.content: I’m sorry for speaking over you. What other feelings might you be having?

dialogue.origin: きちんと話を聞いて、両方の意見をもって話をして欲しいです。
dialogue.content: I want him to listen properly and to consider both sides when we talk.

dialogue.origin: このままです
dialogue.content: That's it.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね相談者様の意見もきちんと聞いてほしいとお思いなんですねそう、ご主人にお伝えしてみたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: I see. You want him to listen properly to your perspective as well. Have you tried communicating that to your husband?

dialogue.origin: 前に少し伝えた事があります。主人はそうしてはいないと、思っているようでした
dialogue.content: I mentioned it to him a little before. He seemed to think that's not what he was doing.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね素直に気持ちをお伝えしていたんですねご主人にそう言われてしまうと少し残念な気持ちになってしまいますね
dialogue.content: I see. You were honest about your feelings. It must have been a bit disappointing to hear him say that.

dialogue.origin: 私の気持ちは言っても分からないのかと思いました
dialogue.content: It made me wonder if he'll ever understand my feelings, even if I tell him.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ、そう思っているんですね
dialogue.content: Yes, yes—that’s how you’re feeling.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: いつもは話をきちんとできるご主人だからこそなんだかショックだったのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Perhaps it was especially shocking because he's usually someone you can talk to properly?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。姑と対立したいわけでもないのに姑を疎ましく感じたりするのもなんだか嫌です
dialogue.content: That's right. I don’t even want to be at odds with my mother-in-law, so feeling resentful toward her bothers me as well.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ誰も悪くないのに、そんな風に感じてしまうのは悲しいですよね
dialogue.content: Yes, yes. It's sad to feel that way when no one is really at fault.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That’s true.

dialogue.origin: ご主人には、今後こうなってくれたら嬉しいなということはありますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything you'd like your husband to do differently in the future that would make you happy?

dialogue.origin: どちらの側にたつのでもなく、自分も一緒に話に入って自分の意思も持って欲しいです
dialogue.content: Rather than taking either side, I want him to join the discussion and have his own point of view.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ、そうなってくれたら相談者様もお姑さんに腹立たしい気持ちを持たなくてもよくなりそうですか？
dialogue.content: Yes, yes. If he did that, do you think it would help you not feel so angry with your mother-in-law?

dialogue.origin: そうだと思います
dialogue.content: I think so.

dialogue.origin: うん、うん、なるほどご主人にそうなってもらえるにはご相談者様は何ができそうですか？
dialogue.content: Mm-hm, I see. What do you think you could do to help your husband move in that direction?

dialogue.origin: もう一度話をしてみるしかないですかね
dialogue.content: I suppose all I can do is try talking with him again.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そうお考えなんですね他にはなにか浮かびますか？
dialogue.content: Mm-hm, that’s what you’re thinking. Does anything else come to mind?

dialogue.origin: 他には思い浮かびません
dialogue.content: Nothing else comes to mind.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねお話の途中ですがお時間になってしまいました。よろしければ、他に何ができるか一緒に考えていきましょうまたご相談に来ていただけると嬉しいです
dialogue.content: I see. I'm sorry to interrupt, but our time is up. If you'd like, we can think more together about what else can be done. I would be happy if you came back for another session.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: ご主人とお姑さんの間で苦しい思いをされえいるご相談者様の気持ちが少しでも楽になったら嬉しいですまたお話を聞かせてください
dialogue.content: I hope this has eased, even a little, the distress you’ve been feeling between your husband and your mother-in-law. Please feel free to talk with me again.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 本日はご相談ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you for your consultation today.

dialogue.origin: (お疲れ様でした)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time.)

dialogue.origin: 終了させていただきます
dialogue.content: This concludes our session.

topic.sub: 姑との関係に対する悩み
